MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink Whole Home Bundle feels like a useful next purchase because I already use a Blink camera, and a doorbell plus additional cameras would expand my home security setup.",
    "The Echo Show 8 fits my interest in connected home devices alongside my Fire TV equipment, with a larger display that I would try for video calls."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire tablets share a name with my Fire TV devices, but portable entertainment does not meet the same need as watching television at home.",
    "The sport earbuds do not connect to any current need in my history of home viewing and security purchases.",
    "The Show 5, Echo Dot, and Blink Mini cameras are relevant, but I would choose the larger Show 8 and broader Blink bundle instead of buying several overlapping devices now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Using Fire TV seems to have been taken as interest in many other Amazon devices, even when they serve different purposes.",
    "My camera purchases seem to have been read as a reason to offer more cameras without enough attention to what each addition would let me do."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases center on home television viewing and security, which makes a useful addition to those activities more appealing than a portable device.",
    "I care about the specific role of an addition: the doorbell expands security coverage, while the larger Alexa display interests me more than a smaller display or a separate speaker."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my connected home interests but stretched shared brands and device similarities beyond the practical uses I want right now."
}
